summary: ends_with_line_break compared the final codepoint against literal strings such as "u{000A}" instead of Unicode escapes, so it returned false for actual line breaks. This caused lightweight line iteration to omit the final empty line after a trailing line break. The fix adds the missing backslashes to recognize the seven supported line-break codepoints. The selected upstream test was added by this fix and checks newline detection directly. No tests were run in this planning job.
